newsitems.title: Announcing Age Twisters | Wishlist now!
newsitems.author: siwoocha
newsitems.contents: Hello!Meet Age Twisters — a 2-player co-op narrative adventure where you become a grandfather and granddaughter, freely switching between ages to solve puzzles together.Wishlist now!Key Features👪 A Family AdventureUncover the mystery of a missing mother through the eyes of a grandfather and granddaughter, slowly piecing together what happened long ago.⚡ A Variety of Ages & AbilitiesSwitch between childhood, teenage, adult, and elder forms in real time, combining each age's unique abilities to overcome every obstacle.🎮 One Game, Two PlayersOnly one player needs to purchase the game — the other plays free via Friends Pass. Full local and online co-op supported.Add to your wishlist and join us on our journey to release.Age Twisters Team
